# Acme Widgets Private Limited

Fictional sample financial statements for testing only. Acme Widgets Private Limited
is an imaginary unlisted private company that manufactures plastic widgets in Pune,
Maharashtra. All names and figures are invented.

## Statement of Profit and Loss for the year ended 31 March 2025

All amounts in Rs. lakhs.

| Particulars                         | FY 2024-25 | FY 2023-24 |
|-------------------------------------|-----------:|-----------:|
| Revenue from operations             |     850.00 |     720.00 |
| Other income                        |      12.50 |       9.00 |
| Total income                        |     862.50 |     729.00 |
| Cost of materials consumed          |     410.00 |     355.00 |
| Employee benefits expense           |     145.00 |     128.00 |
| Finance costs                       |      18.00 |      21.00 |
| Depreciation and amortisation       |      32.00 |      30.00 |
| Other expenses                      |     120.50 |     104.00 |
| Total expenses                      |     725.50 |     638.00 |
| Profit before tax                   |     137.00 |      91.00 |
| Tax expense                         |      34.50 |      23.00 |
| Profit for the year                 |     102.50 |      68.00 |

## Notes

1. The financial statements are prepared on the accrual basis under the historical
   cost convention and comply with the Accounting Standards notified under
   Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.
2. Related party transactions: during the year the company paid rent of Rs. 6.00 lakhs
   to Jane Doe, a director, for the factory premises at Pune.
3. The statutory auditor is Sample & Co., Chartered Accountants, who issued an
   unmodified audit opinion on 15 July 2025.
4. During the year the company accepted a cash loan of Rs. 3.00 lakhs from
   Richard Roe, a relative of a director.
